about.title: Hi, I'm Anne
about.bio1: I specialise in colour tattoos — especially anime, original illustrations and cartoons — but I also love a good blackwork piece.
about.bio2: These styles captivate me not only because I personally identify with them, but because they carry stories, emotional memories and visual references full of feeling and identity.
about.bio3: I have a deep passion for tattooing. I believe making something permanent on the skin is a profound way of expressing ourselves, celebrating who we are and embracing our bodies — this home that stays with us forever. I see tattooing as a powerful meeting point between art and self-esteem, between the line and our true identity.
about.bio4: Every project I create is made with love and careful attention to detail. Everything is designed especially for you 🤍

styles.statement: I mostly tattoo <hl>anime</hl>, <hl>colour</hl> and <hl>blackwork</hl> — characters, original illustrations and cartoons that carry your story.
